Generate ONLY the first-run primary modelling reference, 00_three_quarter.png, following this specification exactly. Use case: stylized-concept, faithful HD game-creature anatomy reference.
INPUTS in order: 1 native_views.png is the original MM8 m492 Dragon identity authority (ignore its background); 2 dragon_master_01_front.png is the accepted whole-dragon HD front material, colour and foreleg reference; 3 dragon_master_03_left.png is the accepted HD left material/colour/anatomy reference. Reconstruct THIS dragon's foreleg, not a new design.
ONE anatomical RIGHT foreleg only, shoulder joint to talon tips. Clean shoulder termination at top: flat oval surface of plain dark scaled skin, no gore. No body, chest, wing or neck.
Charcoal-black small tightly overlapping scales on upper arm and forearm, thin dark-red seams and edges like the masters; slightly larger plates on front forearm and back of hand. Narrow small gold-amber scute strip down BACK of upper arm, matching master ventral scales. ONE short ivory bone spur at wrist pointing backward, distinct from digits; no other spikes.
Exactly FOUR digits and FOUR talons: THREE long forward fingers, each three scaled segments, spread as a downward fan, plus ONE shorter INNER thumb/dewclaw higher on inside wrist. Make all four visibly identifiable and separated. Each digit has one long hooked ivory-cream talon, darker base, thick glossy sharp downward curve, longer than last digit segment. No two talons touch or overlap. Dark leathery pads underside palm/digits. Broad hand; muscular forearm longer than hand.
Pose: shoulder cut at top, leg hangs down, elbow slightly bent, forearm vertical, wrist straight, hand opens down. Three long forward digits fan downward, short inner digit clear. Correct right-side anatomy.
Camera: FRONT THREE-QUARTER showing front and OUTER side of right foreleg, slightly above, near-orthographic at elbow height. The front is the back of the hand/front forearm. Preserve visible inner digit on opposite edge.
Canvas requested 1024x1536 PORTRAIT. Truly transparent alpha background. Entire shoulder cut and all talon tips inside generous margins, nothing cropped. Soft even neutral studio lighting, no dramatic shadows, rim light or glow (lighting will be baked into texture). Sharp high-definition scale/talon detail faithful to reference materials.
NO floor, cast shadow, text, flames, scenery, ground, other body parts, armour, rings, bracelets, gems, chains, scars, extra spikes, extra digits, green/blue/bronze/white scales, perspective distortion or motion blur. Only one view of one foreleg.
